name: Adobe Analytics
description: Web and marketing analytics tool that tracks customer behavior across digital channels to support reporting and audience insights.

name: Application Insights
description: Application performance monitoring feature within Azure Monitor that tracks application usage, performance metrics, and diagnoses issues in live applications.

name: Auvik
description: Cloud-based network monitoring and management tool that automatically maps network devices and traffic to give IT teams visibility and alerts.

name: Azure Log Analytics
description: Cloud-based service within Azure Monitor that collects and queries log and telemetry data from Azure and on-premises resources.

name: Dynatrace
description: Software intelligence platform that provides application performance monitoring, infrastructure monitoring, and observability using AI-driven analysis of cloud and hybrid environments.

name: Fluentd
description: Open-source data collector that unifies log collection and consumption by parsing, filtering, and routing logs to various backends.

name: Grafana
description: Open-source visualization and dashboarding tool used to query, explore, and display metrics and logs from various data sources.

name: Jaeger
description: Open-source distributed tracing system used to monitor and troubleshoot transactions across microservices-based applications.

name: Logstash
description: Server-side data processing pipeline, part of the Elastic Stack, that ingests, transforms, and forwards logs and events to storage or analysis tools.

name: Logz.io
description: Cloud-based log management and observability platform built on open-source tools like ELK, Prometheus, and Jaeger for centralized monitoring.

name: New Relic
description: Cloud-based observability platform offering application performance monitoring, infrastructure metrics, and log management for software systems.

name: NLog
description: Free logging library for .NET applications that supports structured logging and flexible routing of log messages to multiple targets.

name: Prometheus
description: Open-source monitoring system and time-series database that collects and queries metrics, commonly used for alerting in cloud-native and Kubernetes environments.

name: PRTG Network Monitor
description: Network monitoring software that tracks devices, bandwidth, and infrastructure health using various protocols like SNMP and WMI.

name: Serilog
description: Structured logging library for .NET that captures log events as data and supports many output sinks for storage and analysis.

name: Splunk
description: Platform for searching, monitoring, and analyzing machine-generated data such as logs, used for operational intelligence and security analytics.

name: Zabbix
description: Open-source monitoring solution for tracking the availability and performance of networks, servers, virtual machines, and applications.
